children: Geojit Financial Services, SS Retail Ltd

SS Retail Limited (SSRL), incorporated in 2016 and headquartered in Kolhapur, Maharashtra, is a multi-brand mobile and electronics retailer with 503 stores as of FY26, primarily across Tier II/III markets. It is the largest mobile retail chain in West India and Maharashtra and the third-largest in India among peers. SSRL operates under three brands SS Mobile, Mobile Exchange Wala and The Mobile Space, offering smartphones, pre-owned devices and consumer electronics through COFO (CompanyOwned, Franchisee-Operated) and FOFO (Franchisee-Owned, Franchisee-Operated) formats. India’s mobile phone and accessories market stood at ₹4.2 trillion in FY26 and is projected to reach ₹6.2 trillion by FY30, implying a 9.8% CAGR, supported by premiumization, rising ASPs and increasing adoption across Tier II/III markets. (Source: Knowledge Company Report). Store count increased from 236 stores across 109 cities in FY24 to 503 stores across 215 cities in FY26, a ~46% CAGR (~2.4x the peer average), positioning SSRL among the fastest-growing mobile retail chains.
